validationRule.title: GTFS-rt stop_sequence isn't provided for trip that visits same stop_id more than once
validationRule.errorDescription: If a GTFS trip contains multiple references to the same stop_id (i.e., the vehicle visits the same stop_id more than once in the same trip), then GTFS-rt stop_time_updates for this trip must include stop_sequence
validationRule.occurrenceSuffix: more than once and GTFS-rt stop_time_update is missing stop_sequence field - stop_sequence must be provided

validationRule.title: stop_time_update doesn't contain stop_id or stop_sequence
validationRule.errorDescription: All stop_time_updates must contain stop_id or stop_sequence - both fields cannot be left blank

validationRule.title: arrival or departure provided for NO_DATA stop_time_update
validationRule.errorDescription: If a stop_time_update has a schedule_relationship of NO_DATA, then neither arrival nor departure should be provided

validationRule.title: stop_time_update doesn't have arrival or departure
validationRule.errorDescription: If a stop_time_update doesn't have a schedule_relationship of SKIPPED or NO_DATA, then either arrival or departure must be provided

validationRule.title: stop_time_update arrival/departure doesn't have delay or time
validationRule.errorDescription: stop_time_update.arrival and stop_time_update.departure must have either delay or time - both fields cannot be missing
